subject: Senior Full Stack Engineer - React/Next.js/Node, remote
body:
Hi Fueled team,

I saw your Senior Full Stack Engineer posting. I'm a full-stack developer based in
Austria with 4+ years across React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js, and most of
that has been agency work - several client platforms at a time, with the client in
the room rather than behind a product manager.

The part of the posting that matched closest was modelling relational and
non-relational data and implementing effective caching. I work across both: on
Ludwig, the medical practice-management product I lead on now, the domain model
runs on Postgres; on EquipX, a heavy-equipment marketplace, I built the searchable
listing system over MongoDB along with real-time one-to-one and group chat. On
Atomix Logistics I built order and inventory features over MariaDB with Redis
caching to keep the dashboards responsive under load.

I'm on CET but flexible into US hours, and available immediately - contract or
full-time, whichever suits the engagement.

CV attached. Happy to walk through either project on a short call.

Best,
Saif ur Rehman
